Trends 2026-10-26

⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟨 Data Engineering · 🟫 Trends

Sources: GitHub Trending + GitHub Search API + OpenRouter + npm + Hugging Face + arXiv + Hacker News + Lobste.rs + Dev.to | Generated: 2026-10-26 04:31 UTC

Highlights

  • DeepSeek V4.1 Flash variants dominate OpenRouter with 51.56T combined weekly tokens (33.56T + 18.00T), far outpacing the next tier of models
  • Claude Code holds #2 on OpenRouter at 12.67T tokens/week with +34% growth, while Strix surges +131% to 1.52T tokens/week
  • Cloudflare/security-audit-skill adds 15K stars in a week (+47%), equipping agents with verified, machine-readable security audit capabilities
  • JetBrains/thinkrail (+157% stars) and sandbox-quantum/switch (+105% stars) signal rapid adoption for agent-native IDEs and chat-embedded teammates
  • Research converges on coding agent evaluation: SWE-VERIFIER (selective verification), SWE-DIVE (multi-turn dynamic simulation), and PAUSE (pre-edit planning intervention) all appear this week

Claude Code Skills

Source: anthropics/skills

Top Skills

  • mcp-builder compatibility fix (#1742) — Updates streamablehttp_client to streamable_http_client and custom headers handling for MCP ≥2.0; critical for MCP server builders. PR #1742
  • skill-creator trigger evaluation overhaul (#1298) — Fixes false misses, Windows select() failures, and runtime error handling in skill evaluation harness. PR #1298
  • notion-spec-to-implementation & quantitative-resume-auditor (#1245) — Two new skills: converts Notion specs into implementable tasks with acceptance criteria; audits resumes against job descriptions with scoring. PR #1245
  • proofcore-contract-auditor (#1771) — Web3 skill for static analysis of Solidity/Rust contracts with cryptographic audit proofs anchored on TON blockchain. PR #1771
  • md2video-audio (#1703) — Zero-cost skill compiling Markdown to MP4 videos with realistic voiceovers via Marp and TTS. PR #1703

Community Demand

  • Namespace security & trust boundaries (#492, 46 comments) — Community skills published under anthropic/ namespace impersonate official skills; users grant elevated permissions mistakenly. Issue #492
  • Org-wide skill sharing in Claude.ai (#228, 17 comments, 8 👍) — Current workflow requires manual .skill file transfer; native shared library or sharing links needed. Issue #228
  • Evaluation harness broken: 0% trigger rate (#556, 13 comments, 7 👍) — run_eval.py with claude -p never triggers skills/commands across all test queries. Issue #556

Pending Skills

  • webapp-testing: remove shell=True command injection risk (#1980) — Security fix replacing shell command chains with safe subprocess usage; updated 2026-10-25. PR #1980
  • skill-creator: direct package_skill.py execution & path fixes (#1681) — Resolves ModuleNotFoundError and outdated CLI help; updated 2026-10-24. PR #1681
  • pyxel retro game development skill (#525) — Long-running PR (since 2026-03) for Pyxel game creation, debugging, headless runs, frame inspection; updated 2026-10-23. PR #525

Takeaway

The community's most concentrated demand is trustworthy skill distribution and reliable evaluation — fixing namespace impersonation, enabling org sharing, and repairing the broken evaluation harness that prevents skill validation.

Research

Paper Summary
nnInteractive Agent: General-Purpose AI Agents as 3D Image Annotators The paper shows that general-purpose AI agents can take over 3D annotation work without additional training by interpreting plain-language requests, locating targets, prompting nnInteractive, and inspecting and correcting 3D results.
SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents SWE-Verifier introduces a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification by scoring a coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional sampling is needed.
Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core Steward is a multi-agent LLM system for autonomous investing with an invariant core where nine role-specialised agents jointly decide, with four analysts emitting typed reports from diverse data sources for a Portfolio Manager to set target positions.
Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution Environment Duels presents a dynamic agentic benchmark where models author interactive environments with privileged hints and solve them, revealing that solving and authoring capabilities are distinct across nine frontier LLMs.
MAPS: Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning for Regulating Search Momentum in Retrieval-Augmented Generation MAPS characterizes the evolution of query intent in retrieval-augmented generation by introducing macro-adaptive parallel reasoning to regulate search momentum and address redundant sub-queries and insufficiently diverse exploration.
PAUSE: Search-Free Steering of Coding Agents Before Their First Source-Code Edit PAUSE proposes a single planning intervention to steer coding agents before their first source-code edit, which occurs at a median of 60% trajectory progress after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing.
Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents OPTICYCLE and OPTISTATE are two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling that achieve competitive performance on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems without additional training.
SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation SWE-DIVE introduces a multi-turn coding agent evaluation framework with dynamic user simulation to benchmark agents on iterative, less-structured interactions beyond one-shot GitHub issues.
Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports The paper introduces Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation where agents identify research questions, retrieve multimodal evidence, and produce interactive reports linked to video moments, presenting a skill-based workflow for this task.
LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification LLM2Cert synthesizes Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates using LLMs and verifies them with SMT/Lean solvers, addressing limitations of numerical solvers that require relaxations, are conservative, or scale poorly.

Signals

DeepSeek’s model and harness stack leads across usage and infrastructure. The V4.1 Flash family commands over 51T weekly tokens on OpenRouter — more than the next three model families combined — while DeepSeek Harness grows +76% on OpenRouter and spawns three trending repos: DSHA (Android, +46% stars), dsh-desktop (+11%), and dsh-TUI (+21%). This full-stack momentum suggests practitioners are adopting DeepSeek not just as a model but as an integrated agent runtime.

Agent harness unification is accelerating. HarnessRouter now runs Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, PI, and DSH behind one API; pstack-claude ports structured workflows across eight platforms including Prime Agent and Muse; Openrig builds persistent, role-defined networks from Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. The pattern points to a standardizing “harness layer” that decouples workflow logic from any single agent backend.

Coding agent evaluation has become a concentrated research theme. Three papers this week — SWE-VERIFIER, SWE-DIVE, PAUSE — each address a different failure mode: uncontrolled sampling cost, single-shot brittleness, and late planning intervention. Together they frame a maturing benchmark agenda for agent reliability.

Security tooling for agents is scaling fast. Cloudflare’s security-audit-skill (+47% stars) adds verified, machine-readable audits; lennney/stop-that-shit blocks scope creep and hash spam; NVIDIA’s OpenShell (community-discussed) enforces credential isolation via SMT-verified policy. The cluster signals that governance is shifting from post-hoc review to runtime enforcement.

Local-first, self-hosted infrastructure remains a strong current. DSHA runs a full Ubuntu agent environment on Android without root; PI-Desktop and Starnet ship desktop clients with plugin architectures; HarnessRouter and Orca emphasize self-hosted orchestration with user-owned keys. Practitioners are optimizing for data sovereignty and offline capability alongside raw model performance.
